[EN] Out there there's a place called Arachnaea.

Giant spiders, they say. Worse things, they say.

I'm not a praying man, but I hope they never send me there.
[ES] Allá afuera hay un lugar llamado Arachnaea.

Arañas gigantes, dicen. Cosas peores, dicen.

No soy un hombre devoto, pero espero que nunca me envíen allí.
